scope.description: Whole sox application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Audio format conversion, resampling/channel handling, editing/assembly, mixing, filtering/effects, level processing and devices.

coverage.rationale: Connected audio preparation now includes a bounded two-track narration/background overlay alongside assembly, speech conformance and peak normalisation. Broad formats, arbitrary effects, general multitrack work and device workflows remain absent; narrow PCM16 and frame bounds keep this within the existing coarse 25% whole-application estimate.

scope.description: Frame-accurate PCM16 excerpt assembly/fades, speech conformance, explicit peak normalisation and two-track gain/placement mixing with a declared duration policy.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Clip placement, speech-input conformance, target peak levels and two-track composition hide native effect chains. Authors still choose exact sample placements, gains and restricted duration policies; the estimate remains 75% within this named bounded slice.

limitations: Bounded PCM16 files only; mix span is at most 262144 frames (about 5.5 seconds at 48 kHz), so full-length podcast mixing is outside this slice. No more than two simultaneous tracks, crossfade, arbitrary effects, loudness/RMS/true-peak goals or sound-device interaction.
Subjective review of source contracts and bounded evidence, not an exhaustive native API measurement. Named native cases and source-bound qualification are separate from these strength estimates.
